quote: 1. The difference between successful people and really successful people is that really successful people say no to almost everything.

quote: 2. The great lesson in microeconomics is to discriminate between when technology is going to help you and when it's going to kill you.

quote: 3. Speculators are just as necessary to the stock exchange as germs are to medicine.
speaker: André Kostolany

quote: 4. Mimicking the herd invites regression to the mean.

quote: 5. I'm not much interested in the past history of a stock except as it tells me something about the possible reactions of people to future developments.

quote: 7. Do not save what is left after spending, but spend what is left after saving.
speaker: Warren Buffett

quote: 8. The financial markets generally are unpredictable.
speaker: George Soros

quote: 9. Wherever I look, I see nothing but trouble ahead, but that is not a reason for gloom; it's a reason for being active and taking action.

quote: 11. Superior investors get that way because they have superior insight, not superior information.

quote: 12. You don't have to make it back the way that you lost it.

quote: 13. Never test the depth of the river with both feet.

quote: 15. If we avoid the losers, the winners will take care of themselves.

quote: 16. Someone is sitting in the shade today because someone planted a tree a long time ago.

quote: 17. I rely a great deal on animal instincts.

quote: 19. Price is what you pay; value is what you get.

quote: 20. Invert, always invert.

quote: 21. Being too far ahead of your time is indistinguishable from being wrong.

quote: 22. Only buy something that you'd be perfectly happy to hold if the market shut down for 10 years.

quote: 23. We may never know where we're going, but we'd better have a good sense of where we are.

quote: 24. The first rule of compounding: Never interrupt it unnecessarily.

quote: 26. Take a simple idea and take it seriously.

quote: 27. Experience is what you got when you didn't get what you wanted.

quote: 28. Opportunities come infrequently. When it rains gold, put out the bucket, not the thimble.

quote: 29. I never allow myself to have an opinion on anything that I don't know the other side's argument better than they do.

quote: 30. You can't predict. You can prepare.

quote: 31. The most important quality for an investor is temperament, not intellect.

quote: 32. People calculate too much and think too little.

quote: 33. Risk means more things can happen than will happen.

quote: 34. Our favorite holding period is forever.

quote: 35. To the man with only a hammer, every problem looks like a nail.

quote: 36. If investing is entertaining, if you're having fun, you're probably not making any money. Good investing is boring.

quote: 37. Predicting rain doesn't count. Building arks does.

quote: 38. The big money is not in the buying and selling, but in the waiting.

quote: 39. It's not whether you're right or wrong that's important, but how much money you make when you're right and how much you lose when you're wrong.

quote: 40. Risk comes from not knowing what you're doing.

quote: 41. I think it's undeniably true that the human brain must work in models.

quote: 42. Those who have money can speculate; those who have a little money must not speculate; and those who have no money must speculate.

quote: 43. Beware the investment activity that produces applause; the great moves are usually greeted by yawns.
speaker: Warren Buffett

quote: 44. The desire to get rich fast is pretty dangerous.

quote: 45. Markets are constantly in a state of uncertainty and flux, and money is made by discounting the obvious and betting on the unexpected.
speaker: George Soros

quote: 46. The best thing that happens to us is when a great company gets into temporary trouble.

quote: 47. Spend each day trying to be a little wiser than you were when you woke up.

quote: 48. The biggest investing errors come not from factors that are informational or analytical, but from those that are psychological.

quote: 49. The most important investment you can make is in yourself.

quote: 52. Be fearful when others are greedy, and greedy when others are fearful.

quote: 54. I'm only rich because I know when I'm wrong.

quote: 55. Look at market fluctuations as your friend rather than your enemy; profit from folly rather than participate in it.

quote: 57. You can't do the same things others do and expect to outperform.

quote: 58. The business schools reward difficult, complex behavior more than simple behavior, but simple behavior is more effective.
speaker: Warren Buffett

quote: 59. In the long run, it's difficult for a stock to earn a much better return than the business which underlies it earns.

quote: 60. Buy stocks, take sleeping pills, and look at them again after many years. Then you will see: you are rich.

quote: 61. It's far better to buy a wonderful company at a fair price than a fair company at a wonderful price.

quote: 62. The stock market is 90 percent psychology and 10 percent reality.

quote: 63. The world is full of foolish gamblers, and they will not do as well as the patient investor.

quote: 64. The stock market is a device for transferring money from the impatient to the patient.

quote: 65. It is remarkable how much long-term advantage people like us have gotten by trying to be consistently not stupid, instead of trying to be very intelligent.

quote: 66. Rule number one: most things will prove to be cyclical. Rule number two: some of the greatest opportunities for gain and loss come when other people forget rule number one.

quote: 68. It's not greed that drives the world, but envy.

quote: 69. Success carries within itself the seeds of failure, and failure the seeds of success.

quote: 70. It takes 20 years to build a reputation and five minutes to ruin it.

quote: 71. I constantly see people rise in life who are not the smartest, sometimes not even the most diligent, but they are learning machines.

quote: 72. Success in investing doesn't come from buying good things, but from buying things well.

quote: 73. In the business world, the rearview mirror is always clearer than the windshield.

quote: 75. Buy when the cannons thunder, sell when the violins play.

quote: 76. Games are won by players who focus on the playing field — not by those whose eyes are glued to the scoreboard.

quote: 77. Knowing what you don't know is more useful than being brilliant.

quote: 78. Markets are always biased in one direction or another.

quote: 79. Only when the tide goes out do you discover who's been swimming naked.

quote: 80. A majority of life's errors are caused by emotion getting in the way of clear thinking.
speaker: Charlie Munger

quote: 81. You can't eat relative performance.

quote: 82. Never invest in a business you cannot understand.
speaker: Warren Buffett

quote: 83. A lot of people with high IQs are terrible investors because they've got terrible temperaments.
speaker: Charlie Munger

quote: 84. The riskiest thing in the world is the belief that there is no risk.
speaker: Howard Marks

quote: 85. Time is the friend of the wonderful business, the enemy of the mediocre.
speaker: Warren Buffett

quote: 86. It's not given to human beings to have such talent that they can just know everything about everything all the time.
speaker: Charlie Munger

quote: 87. There are old investors, and there are bold investors, but there are no old bold investors.
speaker: Howard Marks

quote: 88. I try to buy stock in businesses that are so wonderful that an idiot can run them. Because sooner or later, one will.
speaker: Warren Buffett

quote: 89. Show me the incentive and I will show you the outcome.
speaker: Charlie Munger

quote: 90. If I have an advantage over others, it's that I'm more aware of my fallibility.
speaker: George Soros
